retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1960s psychedelic collage featuring a central figure framed by a dark, scalloped silhouette and heavy, decorative bubble typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central photographic subject is surrounded by a glowing white aura, set against a dark, cloud-like scalloped frame. The composition is filled with vibrant orange sunbursts, shooting stars, and heavy, decorative typography featuring floral motifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a glowing white outer glow
Dark scalloped silhouette framing the central action
Heavy display type layered over the central subject
Symmetrical decorative elements like shooting stars and peace signs
coreInvariants: Scalloped dark frame with organic, cloud-like edges
Vibrant orange-to-yellow radial gradient behind the subject
Heavy use of white outer glows on central elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A full-body female figure in a dynamic pose occupies the center, scaled to fill the vertical height of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's glowing white aura and the large horizontal title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top heavy typography, move down to the central figure, and rest on the peace sign at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark brown/black scalloped frame provides high-contrast negative space against the light grey outer border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark brown/black for the framing silhouette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange and yellow for the sunburst and top text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Green and red for small decorative stars and floral details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center and top text, contrasted against a dark, low-value frame.
paletteRestrictions: Must include dark earth tones for the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, rounded sans-serif with liquid-like distortions.
letterConstructionRules: Integration of flower icons into letter centers
characterSpecificRedesigns: O-shaped letters replaced or filled with flower motifs
Ascenders and descenders shortened to maintain a compact block shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking multiple weights of the same psychedelic style to create a dense wall of text.
graphicDevices: Peace sign icon in a circle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a central orange sunburst behind a woman in 60s attire with a white glow, framed by a dark brown scalloped silhouette on a grey background with shooting stars.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, psychedelic bubble lettering with red outlines and flower motifs in the center and top, ensuring the text overlaps the central figure slightly.

verificationChecks: Is the frame scalloped and dark?
Does the text contain flower motifs?
Is there a prominent white glow around the central figure?
Are the colors vibrant and warm in the center?

adjustableVariables: Color of the shooting star trails
Density of the floral motifs in the text
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the model

mustAchieve: Legible but heavily stylized bubble type

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is thick and bubbly
Ensure the scalloped frame is dark and organic
Verify the presence of the orange sunburst
Confirm the white glow effect is applied to the subject
Check for the inclusion of 60s icons like stars and peace signs
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central glowing subject with a dark scalloped frame and heavy, flower-infused bubble typography for a 1960s pop aesthetic.
